AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Traffic Safety Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Traffic Safety Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson.
The Traffic Safety Committee, at the direction of the Chairman with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
July 27, 2021. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the City Council with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask the City Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to "pull" the item from the Consent Calendar for discussion.

HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87081694533
Zoom Meeting ID: 870 8169 4533
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 870 8169 4533#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to rolson.hrgreen@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email rolson.hrgreen@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. All speakers will receive 3 minutes to speak during public comment or on the item indicated. If you wish to show any visual aids while you speak during the meeting, you may submit a PDF version (maximum 20 slides) no later than 12PM (Noon) on July 7, 2021 to rolson.hrgreen@pvestates.org Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Traffic Safety Committee Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.
